ud8.6:1.4: “The Buddha, it seems, while wandering in the land of the Magadhans together with a large Saṅgha of mendicants, has arrived at the village of Pāṭali.”
ud8.6:1.6: Seated to one side, the lay followers of Pāṭali Village said to the Buddha:
ud8.6:2.2: “Sir, the guest house has been spread all over with carpets; the seats have been prepared; the water jar has been set up; the oil lamp has been placed.
ud8.6:16.3: Middling rulers or royal chief ministers inclined to build houses at sites possessed by middling deities.
ud8.6:16.4: Lesser rulers or royal chief ministers inclined to build houses at sites possessed by lesser deities.
ud8.6:17.4: So too, Ānanda, the Magadhan chief ministers Sunidha and Vassakāra are building a citadel to keep the Vajjis out.
ud8.6:18.3: Standing to one side, the Magadhan chief ministers Sunidha and Vassakāra said to the Buddha:
